description: FastAPI router module defining REST API endpoints for managing reactions (like/heart) on posts, including reacting, removing reactions, and fetching reaction summaries.

methods.name: react_to_post( post_id: int, reaction: schemas.ReactionCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db), current_user=Depends(auth_utils.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to add a reaction to a post, ensuring one reaction per user per post.

methods.name: remove_reaction( post_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db), current_user=Depends(auth_utils.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to remove a user's reaction from a post.

methods.name: get_reaction_summary(post_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve all reactions for a specific post, summarized by type.

ctags.name: get_reaction_summary
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_reaction_summary(post_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db)):$/

ctags.name: react_to_post
ctags.signature: ( post_id: int, reaction: schemas.ReactionCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db), current_user=Depends(auth_utils.get_current_user), )
